name: Law Of Moses The
overview: The Law of Moses was given to the nation of Israel with awe-inspiring manifestations, as seen in the thunder, lightning, and the fiery presence of God on Mount Sinai (Exodus 19:16-18). It established a covenant marked by strict commands and holiness, requiring the people and priests to sanctify themselves to avoid God's judgment (Exodus 19:21-22). This law served as a foundational covenant of works, revealing God's holiness and justice while preparing the people for the coming of Christ.
